title: Fleet tuning and proactive utilization playbook for Dedicated capacity
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers running Dedicated pools frequently overcommit or undercommit capacity causing either high unit cost (wasted GPU time) or missed throughput SLOs during traffic spikes. Existing telemetry captures pod-level CPU/GPU usage but lacks an end-to-end cost-per-qps model and a recommended action workflow for operators.

Goal: Produce a practical, repeatable playbook and small set of platform features that (1) ingest per-pool traffic shape and model latency profiles, (2) produce actionable right-size recommendations expressed as target pool configs (node counts, slab sizes, quantization profile tiers), (3) surface predicted unit-cost and SLO risk, and (4) provide safe automated actions (recommendation, dry-run, apply-with-approval).

Scope: This ticket drives the engineering work for the playbook + supporting infra prototypes: cost model, utilization signals (effective concurrency, tail-latency-adjusted utilization), a simulation harness to estimate P95/P99 under candidate sizes, and a dashboard + notification workflow for operators. Not in scope: UI polish for Console; storage retention changes for historical telemetry (tracked in follow-up).

Key deliverables:
- Definition of utilization signals and unit-economics formula (tokens-per-second to GPU-hour mapping).
- Simulation harness that replays last 30 days of traffic to estimate SLO risk for candidate pool sizes.
- Right-size recommendation engine producing a ranked set of actions (scale down X% / change slab mix / enable caching profile) with expected cost delta and risk score.
- Operator API to accept/reject recommendations with dry-run and automatic rollback on latency degradation.
- Playbook document with decision tree for manual ops and guardrails for automated mode.

Success metrics:
- Reduce average idle GPU-hours in targeted pools by 20% within 30 days of rollout to pilot customers.
- Maintain P95 latency SLO violations <= baseline + 5% during pilot.
- >60% of recommendations accepted by operators in first 2 weeks of pilot (indicating signal quality).

Non-functional constraints:
- Simulation throughput must process 30 days of traffic for a pool in < 6 hours for batch recommendation jobs.
- All decisions and recommendation logs must be auditable and retained per compliance policy (retention handled by separate ticket).

Artifacts and references:
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/dedicated/fleet-tuning-playbook (draft)
- Initial cost model notebook: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/cost-modeling/dedicated-prototype
- Related Linear tickets: ENG-20719, ENG-58209, ENG-50321
- Incident runbook that motivated this work: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/2025-11-dedicated-spike
